faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Have another question? Message us on WhatsApp.

items.a: You pay 60% of the total price when you order, which allows us to buy and ship your vehicle. The remaining 40% is only due once your car has arrived in Dakar, when you pick it up.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept Wave, Orange Money and cash at our Sicap Foire office (Airport Highway, opposite Keur Yoff, Dakar).

items.q: How long does delivery from Canada to Dakar take?
items.a: The timeline depends on the vehicle, the shipping schedule and port formalities. We give you an estimate with your quote and keep you informed throughout the journey.

items.q: Can I choose my own vehicle?
items.a: Yes. You can send us a specific vehicle you have found, or simply your criteria (brand, model, year, budget) and we will look for the best options in Canada.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Your contact person keeps you informed at every key step: purchase, inspection, loading, ship departure and arrival in Dakar. You can also message us on WhatsApp at any time to check on your order.

items.q: What happens if the vehicle has a problem?
items.a: The vehicle is inspected before purchase and we share the available information with you. If an issue is found before purchase, we offer you another option. The applicable terms are detailed with your quote.
We support you with the customs clearance formalities on arrival in Dakar. Customs fees depend on the vehicle; we explain them when we prepare your quote.
